```yaml
name: Create Release for Tag

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get tag name
        id: get_tag
        run: echo "tag_name=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.tag_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ env.tag_name }}
          body: |
            ## Enhancements in this release
            
            - Fixed screensaver path bug
            - More frequent fireworks
            - Renamed `screensavers` directory to `gallery`
            - Added name-based screensaver selection with tab-completion
            - Version bump
            - Updated README with list of screensavers
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./bash-screensavers-${{ env.tag_name }}.tar.gz
          asset_name: bash-screensavers-${{ env.tag_name }}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Add DotSlash files to release
        uses: facebook/dotslash-publish-release@v2
        with:
          config: .github/dotslash-config.json
          tag: ${{ env.tag_name }}
```
